posts.cooked:
Over on Reddit someone noticed five new achievements got added to Steam: BOT Chrono, Extremist Sky, Requital Cosmic, Unleashed Visionary, and Conductor Argent.

(Interesting catch, since on Android the new achievements are all marked as "Secret".)

Not too surprising since we've seen the first four previewed already, just not Morally Ambiguous Anthony yet.
